name: m30_power
notes: P_tweezer scales the edge-chain power by the ratio of line peaks per unit guided power (y axis only). If the emitter pitch must grow to suppress coupling, the x field per engine shrinks by x_field_fraction (or the port count must grow by its inverse).

inputs.edge: m14 wave (Weierstrass + aplanat, beta 0.7) x T_facet(SiO2) x FDTD/Kirchhoff x m27 mirror pair (silver M1, TIR M2): 57.7 mW per 1.2 mK tweezer
inputs.tile: m30 imaging design x FDTD directionality x (1 - back-reflection)
inputs.x_axis: unchanged (same engine and x relay); the emitter pitch cost is in m30_coupling
